name: session-trail
description: Companion to the Claude Sessions panel: records when VS Code shows or hides each session (for the panel's Alt+Q history); the read-sessions skill, which finds and reads your other sessions; and the session hive, which tells each session who else is live in its workspace, marks messages from other sessions as not the user's word, and keeps them from waking long, parked or over-limit sessions, and refuses a session's first edit of a file another session has been editing, logging it where that session sees it; sessions can start sub-sessions and hand threads to each other, record decisions, roles and notes in a shared log, and see what other sessions did since their last prompt.
